Description: One reduced word of the norm-5 quaternion tree (generators 1±2i, 1±2j, 1±2k, the Lubotzky-Phillips-Sarnak set for p = 5) of length at most 25, as a 59-bit bijective mixed-radix id: id(w) = number of reduced words shorter than w plus the rank of w (base 6 for the first letter, base 5 after). The word is an exact integer quaternion of norm 5^len (right division recovers it) and an exact point of H^3 under the octahedral boost t = 3/4 (tau = ln 7). Proposed by Hyperbolic Lexicon (Ebayednoob, Pages/Hyperbolic Lexicon/proposals). Form 0xA is unused in this registry; inside Owl Academy and BioChain-AI shdccp/2 streams Form 10 is the ROT gate, and this kernel is never emitted there.
